summary: CLI scaffolder (create-barkpark-app) that bootstraps new Barkpark-powered apps from starter templates — website-starter or blog-starter — with interactive prompts, variable substitution, optional dependency install, git init, and a hosted-demo mode pointing at barkpark.dev instead of local docker-compose.

intentions.title: Zero-friction first run: get a new project to 'it works' in one command
intentions.evidence: index.ts chains prompts → scaffold → install → git-init → printNextSteps; --yes flag skips all interaction; post-install.ts prints exact next commands

intentions.title: Template variable injection to personalise scaffolded output
intentions.evidence: scaffold.ts renderTemplate() substitutes {{projectName}}, {{pmCommand}}, {{barkparkVersion}} in all text files; .tmpl suffix marks substitution targets

intentions.title: Hosted demo onramp: let evaluators skip local infrastructure
intentions.evidence: hosted.ts removes docker-compose files, writes .env.local pointing at https://barkpark.dev, and enables HostedDemoBanner in layout.tsx

intentions.title: Package-manager agnosticism so the DX matches the user's existing toolchain
intentions.evidence: pm.ts detects npm/pnpm/yarn/bun from environment; pmCommand threaded through scaffold vars and install/printNextSteps so all instructions use the detected PM

intentions.title: Graceful CI/non-interactive usage via --yes and flag overrides
intentions.evidence: index.ts --yes flag, --skip-install, --skip-git flags; prompts.ts short-circuits all p.* calls when yesFlag is true, returning defaults directly
